response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short of this executive-level role's hard requirements: his German is self-reported as basic (the role requires minimum C1), and his career shows no formal team leadership, technical project management, or head-of-development experience. His mentoring activities and founder experience are positive signals, but they do not offset the language gap and lack of proven leadership at the required level.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software development experience across web, backend, embedded, and mobile systems
Strong open-source commitment (GISCollective founder, D-language libraries, FOSS4G speaker) and solid Linux background
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and community talks
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal experience leading teams, managing projects, or holding executive/leadership positions
No demonstrated UML, requirements management, or client-facing architecture consulting experience; Python not listed among skills

key_factors.factor: German language gap (basic vs. required C1)
Lack of formal leadership and project management track record
Strong open-source and Linux engineering background
